procedure.method: Independent fresh portfolio review. Read the exact pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, compact addendum and adapter contract; verified pins and PNG dimensions, and read all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following embedded paths. The packet supplies no source assets or protected-layout manifests. Actually opened and visually inspected the exact 15 poster assets through tools.view_image with detail original, sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same three-view order. Only after the M5 thumbnail completed did I begin deliberate copy reading/transcription, aesthetic judgment and scores, using the displayed pinned pixels. No image editing, crops, replacement assets, OCR, peer records, agent spawning, resume, fork or invented session/tool-event identity. No ambiguity-triggered revisits were needed. All natives are 1672 by 941: height differs from 1672*9/16 by exactly 0.5 pixel, so ratio PASS uses the predeclared nearest-integer-single-edge rule, not mathematical equality. Usage views are 720 by 405 and thumbnails 320 by 180, consistent with integer-rounded aspect-preserving reductions.
